Guillermo's own take for Wed, Nov 25 (his read, quote it as his, not yours): The southeast storm is easing this morning. At 6am Sand Heads read SSE 17, down from 28 at 4am. Pam Rocks was S 15 gusting 24, a bit ahead of the page.

White Rock is already going and  Tsawwassen south side 8:15am to 1pm, SSE 19 to 20, tide above 11ft all day. Boundary Bay is the easier call, 9am to noon, SSE 14 to 15. Check before driving: if Sand Heads still reads SSE 15 or more at 7:30, go.  Erwin should also be on as Point Atkinson is already gusting 30 knots.  Wind should ease by noon and pick up my late afternoon again.
